title: Looking for playtesters: slow dark fantasy extraction RPG with classic MMO controls (free, solo, early)
author: zanemoore575
selftext:
>I'm making my first game, and no stranger has played it yet. It's rough and very early, so I want honest reactions.  
>  
>You carry a lantern into a holy city that died at its own festival, take what you can and try to get out. Light keeps the dead back, but it makes you easy to find. The fights are slow and deliberate, tab-target with abilities on a hotbar. This demo is one small corner of the city, solo, and a raid lasts up to about 20 minutes.  
>  
>What I'd love to know:  
>  
>  
>  
>Feedback here, on the itch page, or on Discord. Both downloads are unsigned, so Windows and Mac will warn you; the page says what to click.  
>  
>Up front: the code is written with AI, and so are the icons and UI art. The stories are entirely mine, and the world, sound and music are by the artists in the credits.  
>  
>[https://middafrostey.itch.io/nightfall](https://middafrostey.itch.io/nightfall)  
>  
>The clip is real in-game footage, with some moments staged for the camera. Music: "Mourning Song" and "Lost Time" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 ([https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)).
